name: fugal-dstack-test
docker_compose_file:
services:
  nginx:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    restart: unless-stopped
  attest:
    image: alpine/socat:latest
    volumes:
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
    ports:
      - "8091:8091"
    command: TCP-LISTEN:8091,fork,reuseaddr UNIX-CONNECT:/var/run/dstack.sock
    restart: unless-stopped
pre_launch_script:
#!/bin/sh
# Prelaunch script - runs before starting containers
